svg.text: ClaimSense AI × AutoSure Insurance — reference architecture (M1)
Every arrow is a labelled data flow (F1–F19, legend below). Blue = deterministic code · Orange = model judgment · Green = human · Grey = systems/data · Purple = operations. Synthetic data only.
HUMAN — a licensed adjuster is accountable for every outcome
DETERMINISTIC CODE — identity · access · dates · money (never a model)
MODEL JUDGMENT — reads the file, judges, explains; every judgment cites its evidence
DETERMINISTIC CODE — the one governed door to client systems
SYSTEMS OF RECORD (synthetic, Docker mocks in the pilot) · AWS DATA SERVICES
Streamlit · ECS Fargate · shows computed vs judgment
DATA BOUNDARY — MCP server (API Gateway + Lambda)
verify JWT · entitlement IN CODE before data · same error for missing/forbidden · Idempotency-Key on writes · audit EVERY call
eval gate: fail → no image push
Adjuster signs in at Cognito (OIDC); the JWT carries user + groups to the console.
Adjuster opens a claim; console sends claim_id + JWT to the Orchestrator API (HTTPS).
Orchestrator asks the boundary to AUTHORIZE the claim before any agent runs. Deny → refusal, no claim
Boundary → claims management: get_claim, get_claim_history (typed, scoped).
Boundary → document store: list_documents, get_document. Text is UNTRUSTED and injection-scanned.
Boundary → policy administration: get_policy (feeds the deterministic date and money checks).
Orchestrator → deterministic checks: loss inside policy term, net payable, repair÷ACV, $25K authority.
Orchestrator → agents: PII-masked file bundle, untrusted text wrapped as data; fixed handoffs ①→②→③→④.
Agents ↔ OpenAI API: prompts out, structured responses back (all four agents; masked inputs only).
Coverage Check calls search_clauses through the boundary; it may cite only clause IDs returned.
Boundary → OpenSearch retrieval; chunks failing manifest provenance are quarantined. S3 corpus is indexed.
DecisionCard → guardrails: code overwrites computed fields, verifies citations ⊆ retrieved, forces
post_recommendation with an Idempotency-Key → claims management (a draft, never final). Blocked cards →
Decision card shown in the console with computed vs judgment fields and verdict_source labelled.
Human-only confirm/override via the boundary (agent identities are refused; override needs a reason).
Every boundary call writes an append-only audit record (DynamoDB), streamed to CloudWatch.
Orchestrator traces, latency (p95), error rate and call volume → CloudWatch dashboard + alarm.
GitHub Actions runs the eval gate; only a passing build pushes an image to ECR, which ECS deploys.
Secrets Manager hands the OpenAI key to the orchestrator at runtime (never in code, git or a prompt).
